## 💬 Test 03 — WhatsApp (Simulated)
Webhook that accepts the **same JSON shape Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API sends**, so the real channel can replace it later without touching the normalizer.

Send tests from the Channel Simulator (WhatsApp tab) or curl.

Later swap: replace this Webhook with the **WhatsApp Trigger** node — the Code node already handles both shapes.

## 🛡️ Phase 9 · Safety
**Check Duplicate → Is Duplicate?** sits between *Is Valid Message?* (true) and *Send to Core*.
**Fallback Reply** is connected to the **error output** of *Send to Core* (Settings → On Error → Continue (using error output)).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ reply: 'Sorry, we\'re having a temporary technical problem. Your message has been received and a member of the Tillstone team will get back to you shortly.', fallback: true }) }}
